manifestTitle: SOUND OF TIMES — Forest Record 003 Natural Sound Library & Acoustic Attribution Manifest
publisher: Sound of Times Earth Archive Audio Engineering
notice: All natural environmental acoustic layers (wind, leaves, birds, insects, water, weather) are procedurally modeled and synthesized in real time via Tone.js / Web Audio API. This ensures 100% offline, zero-latency, zero-asset-failure resilience across all environments while remaining inspired by authentic acoustic ecological surveys from the National Park Service and US Forest Service Natural Sounds collection.
